The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the RMS Titanic.

To explain the complex concept of blockchain technology using an analogy: Imagine a community notebook where everyone writes down every transaction that happens in their village. Instead of keeping this notebook in one person's house (which could be lost, stolen, or tampered with), every single villager has an identical copy of the notebook. When a new transaction occurs, it is announced to the whole village. The villagers then check their own notebooks to verify the transaction is valid. Once the majority agrees it is correct, everyone writes the new entry into their own notebooks at the same time. Because everyone has a copy and must agree on changes, it is nearly impossible for anyone to secretly alter the records without everyone else noticing. This makes the system secure and trustworthy, just like the decentralized ledger described in the evidence.
